owner_authorization.scope: Replace the rejected thin MA-only proposal with a review-only geometry that reflects the three Owner-drawn red reference boxes. No full relabeling or training is authorized by this correction alone.

question: Does a two-span box—pre-release core for vertical price bounds and three early confirmation bars for horizontal context—match the Owner's red launch-origin boxes better than the rejected MA-only box?
single_variable_statement: This is an explicitly Owner-directed bundled protocol correction, not a model-performance experiment. It preserves the exact 50 identities, W20 crops and pixels from v1, while changing only the proposed overlay semantics: fixed t-3 core end, core wick plus six-MA vertical bounds, and horizontal extension through three confirmation bars.

owner_reference_measurements.observation: The first expansion candle leaves the box vertically while the box retains its horizontal launch context.
The early dump continues below the red price zone; its later lows do not enlarge the vertical box.
The box covers the launch-origin zone and early rise, while later expansion leaves through the top.

reference_use_guard: The three Owner-provided screenshot pixels are protocol-design references only. Their underlying OHLCV was not fetched or read, they are not holdout evaluation rows, and they cannot enter training inputs or labels.

geometry.horizontal_extent: From the first core candle through anchor t inclusive, producing 7/8/9/10 total bars.
geometry.vertical_extent: Max/min union of core candle full wicks and SMA/EMA 20/60/120 only; confirmation values are excluded.
geometry.extreme_wick_policy: If max core candle range / median core candle range is at least 8, mark unavailable/IGNORE; never clip or winsorize.
geometry.old_overlay: Rejected v1 L5/min24 MA-only box remains visible as a cyan dashed audit baseline.
geometry.new_overlay: Red rectangle is the two-span proposal; yellow divider marks the last core candle before the three confirmation bars.

gates.next_gate: Owner first checks the rendered v2 samples. If the semantics are accepted, use indexed per-image START/END annotation; do not assign all 9,938 boxes with a batch offset or random length.
